<section class="level1" id="le-programme">
<h1>Le programme</h1>
<section class="level2" id="ce-que-ce-chapitre-reprend">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="ce-que-ce-chapitre-reprend">Ce que ce chapitre reprend</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les vingt et un chapitres, en quelques lignes</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Ce qu’on refait</th>
<th>Chapitres</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Dénombrement</td>
<td>3 à 5</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Lois discrètes et leurs quantiles</td>
<td>13 à 15</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Lois continues et la table normale</td>
<td>16 à 19</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Simulation et vérification des théorèmes</td>
<td>20, 21</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le but n’est pas d’apprendre un logiciel</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>C’est de <strong>vérifier</strong> les résultats calculés à la main et de comprendre la logique de nommage des fonctions — qui est la même partout.</p>
<p>Savoir lire une table normale reste utile : c’est ce qui permet de repérer un résultat aberrant, qu’aucun logiciel ne signalera.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="la-logique-de-nommage">
<h1>La logique de nommage</h1>
<section class="level2" id="quatre-lettres-et-tout-est-dit">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="quatre-lettres-et-tout-est-dit">Quatre lettres, et tout est dit</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La convention de R</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 33%"/>
<col style="width: 33%"/>
<col style="width: 33%"/>
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Préfixe</th>
<th>Rôle</th>
<th>Question</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>d</code></td>
<td>densité ou <span class="math inline">P(X = k)</span></td>
<td>quelle probabilité pour cette valeur ?</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>p</code></td>
<td>répartition <span class="math inline">F(x)</span></td>
<td>quelle probabilité en dessous ?</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>q</code></td>
<td>quantile <span class="math inline">F^{-1}(\alpha)</span></td>
<td>quelle valeur pour cette probabilité ?</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>r</code></td>
<td>tirage aléatoire</td>
<td>simuler</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">On accole le nom de la loi</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>binom</code>, <code>pois</code>, <code>geom</code>, <code>unif</code>, <code>exp</code>, <code>norm</code>, <code>chisq</code>, <code>t</code>, <code>f</code>.</p>
<p><code>dbinom</code>, <code>pnorm</code>, <code>qpois</code>, <code>rexp</code> : les trente-six fonctions du cours se déduisent de deux listes. <strong>Il n’y a rien d’autre à mémoriser.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sur-r">
<h1>Sur R</h1>
<section class="level2" id="le-dénombrement">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-dénombrement">Le dénombrement</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb1-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">factorial</span>(<span class="dv">5</span>)          <span class="co"># 120</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">choose</span>(<span class="dv">10</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>)         <span class="co"># 120  : le comité du chapitre 4</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">choose</span>(<span class="dv">49</span>, <span class="dv">5</span>)         <span class="co"># 1906884 : les grilles de loterie</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">prod</span>(<span class="dv">12</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">10</span>)           <span class="co"># 1320 : l'arrangement A(12,3)</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Trois remarques</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>choose(n, k)</code> est <span class="math inline">\binom{n}{k}</span> ; il n’existe pas de fonction pour <span class="math inline">A_n^k</span>, mais <code>prod(n:(n-k+1))</code> la donne.</p>
<p><code>factorial(170)</code> est le dernier calcul possible : au-delà, R renvoie <code>Inf</code>. <strong>Ne calculez jamais les factorielles séparément.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-portefeuille-de-crédits">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-portefeuille-de-crédits">Le portefeuille de crédits</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb2-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-1" tabindex="-1"></a>n <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">200</span> ; p <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fl">0.04</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">dbinom</span>(<span class="dv">8</span>, n, p)          <span class="co"># 0.1424619  : exactement 8 défauts</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="dv">1</span> <span class="sc">-</span> <span class="fu">pbinom</span>(<span class="dv">13</span>, n, p)     <span class="co"># 0.0312124  : au moins 14 défauts</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">qbinom</span>(<span class="fl">0.99</span>, n, p)       <span class="co"># 15         : le quantile à 99 %</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-6" tabindex="-1"></a>n<span class="sc">*</span>p                      <span class="co"># 8          : E(X)</span></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sqrt</span>(n<span class="sc">*</span>p<span class="sc">*</span>(<span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">-</span>p))          <span class="co"># 2.771281   : sigma(X)</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Les cinq chiffres du chapitre 14</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Le capital réglementaire s’écrit alors en une ligne :</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb3-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-1" tabindex="-1"></a>(<span class="fu">qbinom</span>(<span class="fl">0.99</span>, n, p) <span class="sc">-</span> n<span class="sc">*</span>p) <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="dv">100000</span>   <span class="co"># 700000 dirhams</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="poisson-et-lapproximation">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="poisson-et-lapproximation">Poisson et l’approximation</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb4-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">dpois</span>(<span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="at">lambda =</span> <span class="dv">8</span>)        <span class="co"># 0.1395865  contre 0.1424619</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">ppois</span>(<span class="dv">14</span>, <span class="at">lambda =</span> <span class="dv">8</span>)       <span class="co"># 0.9827430  contre 0.9847500</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le contrôle par une seconde méthode</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Deux calculs indépendants qui s’accordent à trois millièmes près : le résultat est fiable.</p>
<p>C’est la vérification la moins coûteuse qui soit, et elle prend une ligne.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-loi-normale">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-loi-normale">La loi normale</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb5-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">pnorm</span>(<span class="fl">1.25</span>)                     <span class="co"># 0.8943502  la table du chapitre 17</span></span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">pnorm</span>(<span class="dv">9000</span>, <span class="at">mean =</span> <span class="dv">7158</span>, <span class="at">sd =</span> <span class="dv">1470</span>)   <span class="co"># 0.8949083</span></span>
<span id="cb5-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="dv">1</span> <span class="sc">-</span> <span class="fu">pnorm</span>(<span class="dv">9000</span>, <span class="dv">7158</span>, <span class="dv">1470</span>)     <span class="co"># 0.1050917  les salaires élevés</span></span>
<span id="cb5-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb5-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">qnorm</span>(<span class="fl">0.975</span>)                    <span class="co"># 1.959964</span></span>
<span id="cb5-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">qnorm</span>(<span class="fl">0.99</span>)                     <span class="co"># 2.326348</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La table entière tient dans une fonction</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>pnorm(z)</code> <strong>est</strong> la table. Elle accepte directement <span class="math inline">m</span> et <span class="math inline">\sigma</span>, ce qui dispense même de standardiser.</p>
<p><code>qnorm</code> fait la lecture inverse — et donne le <span class="math inline">1{,}96</span> de tous les intervalles de confiance.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sur-python">
<h1>Sur Python</h1>
<section class="level2" id="le-module-scipy.stats">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-module-scipy.stats">Le module <code>scipy.stats</code></h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb6-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> scipy <span class="im">import</span> stats</span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> math <span class="im">import</span> comb, factorial</span>
<span id="cb6-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb6-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-4" tabindex="-1"></a>comb(<span class="dv">10</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>)                    <span class="co"># 120</span></span>
<span id="cb6-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-5" tabindex="-1"></a>factorial(<span class="dv">5</span>)                   <span class="co"># 120</span></span>
<span id="cb6-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb6-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-7" tabindex="-1"></a>n, p <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">200</span>, <span class="fl">0.04</span></span>
<span id="cb6-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-8" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.binom.pmf(<span class="dv">8</span>, n, p)       <span class="co"># 0.14246191  -&gt; le d de R</span></span>
<span id="cb6-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="dv">1</span> <span class="op">-</span> stats.binom.cdf(<span class="dv">13</span>, n, p)  <span class="co"># 0.03121238  -&gt; le p de R</span></span>
<span id="cb6-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-10" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.binom.ppf(<span class="fl">0.99</span>, n, p)    <span class="co"># 15.0        -&gt; le q de R</span></span>
<span id="cb6-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-11" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.binom.rvs(n, p, size<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">5</span>)  <span class="co"># simulation  -&gt; le r de R</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-module-scipy.stats-suite">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-module-scipy.stats-suite">Le module <code>scipy.stats</code> (suite)</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La même logique, d’autres noms</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>R</th>
<th>Python</th>
<th>Rôle</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>dbinom</code></td>
<td><code>binom.pmf</code></td>
<td>probabilité d’une valeur</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>pbinom</code></td>
<td><code>binom.cdf</code></td>
<td>fonction de répartition</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>qbinom</code></td>
<td><code>binom.ppf</code></td>
<td>quantile</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>rbinom</code></td>
<td><code>binom.rvs</code></td>
<td>tirage</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="les-lois-continues">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="les-lois-continues">Les lois continues</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb7-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-1" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.norm.cdf(<span class="fl">1.25</span>)                    <span class="co"># 0.8943502</span></span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-2" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.norm.cdf(<span class="dv">9000</span>, loc<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">7158</span>, scale<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1470</span>)   <span class="co"># 0.8949083</span></span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-3" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.norm.ppf(<span class="fl">0.99</span>)                    <span class="co"># 2.3263479</span></span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-5" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.expon.cdf(<span class="dv">3</span>, scale<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span><span class="op">/</span><span class="fl">0.2</span>)         <span class="co"># 0.4511884</span></span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-6" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.poisson.pmf(<span class="dv">8</span>, mu<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">8</span>)              <span class="co"># 0.1395865</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Une seule précaution, mais elle compte</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Python attend <code>scale</code>, c’est-à-dire l’<strong>écart-type</strong> pour la normale et <strong><span class="math inline">1/\lambda</span></strong> pour l’exponentielle.</p>
<p>Écrire <code>scale=0.2</code> au lieu de <code>scale=1/0.2</code> donne un résultat parfaitement plausible et parfaitement faux. <strong>C’est l’erreur la plus fréquente du passage de R à Python.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="vérifier-les-deux-théorèmes">
<h1>Vérifier les deux théorèmes</h1>
<section class="level2" id="la-loi-des-grands-nombres">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-loi-des-grands-nombres">La loi des grands nombres</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb8-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">2024</span>)</span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-2" tabindex="-1"></a>lancers <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sample</span>(<span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">6</span>, <span class="dv">100000</span>, <span class="at">replace =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb8-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-3" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">cumsum</span>(lancers) <span class="sc">/</span> <span class="fu">seq_along</span>(lancers)</span>
<span id="cb8-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb8-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-5" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes[<span class="dv">10</span>]      <span class="co"># 3.900000</span></span>
<span id="cb8-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-6" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes[<span class="dv">1000</span>]    <span class="co"># 3.472000</span></span>
<span id="cb8-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-7" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes[<span class="dv">100000</span>]  <span class="co"># 3.499870</span></span>
<span id="cb8-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-8" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb8-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">plot</span>(moyennes, <span class="at">log =</span> <span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="at">type =</span> <span class="st">"l"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb8-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">abline</span>(<span class="at">h =</span> <span class="fl">3.5</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"red"</span>, <span class="at">lwd =</span> <span class="dv">2</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La figure du chapitre 19, reproduite en cinq lignes</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Sur dix lancers, la moyenne vaut <span class="math inline">3{,}9</span> ; sur cent mille, <span class="math inline">3{,}4999</span>.</p>
<p><strong>Changez la graine et refaites : la trajectoire sera différente, la limite identique.</strong> C’est exactement ce que le théorème affirme.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-théorème-central-limite">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-théorème-central-limite">Le théorème central limite</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb9-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">2024</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-2" tabindex="-1"></a>n <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">30</span></span>
<span id="cb9-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-3" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">replicate</span>(<span class="dv">10000</span>, <span class="fu">mean</span>(<span class="fu">sample</span>(<span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">6</span>, n, <span class="at">replace =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)))</span>
<span id="cb9-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb9-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mean</span>(moyennes)   <span class="co"># 3.499  -&gt; m = 3.5</span></span>
<span id="cb9-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sd</span>(moyennes)     <span class="co"># 0.312  -&gt; sigma/sqrt(n) = 1.708/sqrt(30) = 0.312</span></span>
<span id="cb9-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-7" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb9-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">hist</span>(moyennes, <span class="at">breaks =</span> <span class="dv">40</span>, <span class="at">freq =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">curve</span>(<span class="fu">dnorm</span>(x, <span class="fl">3.5</span>, <span class="fl">1.708</span><span class="sc">/</span><span class="fu">sqrt</span>(<span class="dv">30</span>)), <span class="at">add =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"red"</span>, <span class="at">lwd =</span> <span class="dv">2</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Trois vérifications d’un coup</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>La moyenne des moyennes vaut bien <span class="math inline">m = 3{,}5</span>.</li>
<li>Leur écart-type vaut bien <span class="math inline">\sigma/\sqrt{n} = 0{,}312</span>.</li>
<li>L’histogramme épouse la courbe normale — alors que le dé est parfaitement plat.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-même-en-python">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-même-en-python">Le même en Python</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb10-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> numpy <span class="im">as</span> np</span>
<span id="cb10-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-2" tabindex="-1"></a>rng <span class="op">=</span> np.random.default_rng(<span class="dv">2024</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb10-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-4" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes <span class="op">=</span> rng.integers(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">7</span>, size<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">10000</span>, <span class="dv">30</span>)).mean(axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-5" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb10-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-6" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes.mean()   <span class="co"># 3.4995</span></span>
<span id="cb10-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-7" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes.std()    <span class="co"># 0.3119</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La simulation comme outil de gestion</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Ce que nous venons de faire s’appelle une simulation de <strong>Monte-Carlo</strong>. Trois lignes suffisent.</p>
<p>Quand une loi est trop compliquée à calculer — un portefeuille aux actifs corrélés, un projet aux flux incertains — <strong>on ne calcule plus : on simule dix mille scénarios et l’on lit le quantile</strong>. C’est la méthode dominante en finance de marché.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="ce-quil-faut-retenir">
<h1>Ce qu’il faut retenir</h1>
<section class="level2" id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">Le résumé du chapitre</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Six points</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>Quatre préfixes en R — <code>d</code>, <code>p</code>, <code>q</code>, <code>r</code> — et le nom de la loi : trente-six fonctions en deux listes.</li>
<li>En Python : <code>pmf</code>/<code>pdf</code>, <code>cdf</code>, <code>ppf</code>, <code>rvs</code> dans <code>scipy.stats</code>.</li>
<li><code>pnorm</code> et <code>norm.cdf</code> remplacent la table ; <code>qnorm</code> en fait la lecture inverse.</li>
<li>Attention au <code>scale</code> de Python : écart-type pour la normale, <span class="math inline">1/\lambda</span> pour l’exponentielle.</li>
<li>Cinq lignes reproduisent la loi des grands nombres, cinq autres le théorème central limite.</li>
<li>Quand le calcul devient impossible, la <strong>simulation</strong> donne la réponse.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La fin du cours</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Nous sommes partis d’un dé et de six fréquences. Nous arrivons au capital réglementaire d’une banque et à la marge d’erreur d’un sondage.</p>
<p>Rien de nouveau n’a été inventé en chemin : la moyenne est devenue espérance, la fréquence probabilité, le tableau de contingence loi jointe. <strong>Le calcul des probabilités est bien l’autre face de la statistique descriptive</strong> — et il ouvre maintenant sur la statistique inférentielle, où l’on remontera de l’échantillon vers la population.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
